# Riddhy Furnitures (RF Riddhy)
> Leading furniture showroom, home appliances, and kitchen utensils destination in Prayagraj & Mansoorabad, Uttar Pradesh, India.

## Business Overview
- **Name**: Riddhy Furnitures (RF Riddhy)
- **Legal Entity**: Riddhy Furnitures and Home Appliances

## Core Offerings
1. **Furniture**: Solid Sheesham & Teak wood double beds, hydraulic storage beds, designer sofa sets, wooden wardrobes, steel almirahs (Triveni / Godrej style), dressing tables (shringardan), dining tables and chairs, mattresses, and plastic tables/chairs.
2. **Home Appliances**: Refrigerators, washing machines, smart LED televisions, air conditioners, dessert & window coolers, chimneys, water purifiers, and mixer grinders.
3. **Kitchen Utensils**: Tri-ply stainless steel cookware, induction-base bhagonas, pressure cookers, insulated casserole hotpot sets, dinner sets (51-piece & 61-piece), cutlery sets, and traditional brass/copper water drums.
4. **Wedding & Dowry Packages (Shagun Packages)**: Complete wedding furniture and appliance packages tailored for UP weddings, including double bed, almirah, dressing table, sofa set, fridge, washing machine, cooler, and full utensil sets with doorstep delivery and setup.

## Key Policies
- **Delivery**: Free doorstep delivery within Prayagraj & Mansoorabad region.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery, UPI, Debit/Credit Cards, Net Banking, and No-Cost EMI options.
- **Warranty**: Up to 10-year warranty on solid wood furniture frames; manufacturer brand warranty on all appliances.
